ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.3 Playtest introduces the first worker-side path computation stage. For supported long OnCell paths, the main thread captures an immutable PathGrid snapshot and RimMT workers run an independent A* with per-thread scratch state. Results are compared against vanilla PawnPath geometry and topology generation; vanilla remains authoritative in this validation build. This is designed to validate worker safety and compatibility before worker-computed paths are allowed to replace vanilla results.
